milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The gold block is on a polished andesite pedestal at spawn-relative (3, 2, 5), ~6.16 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk at least 1-2 blocks toward the gold block (since spawn distance 6.16 > 5), preventing pre-satisfaction at spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking at the gold block when nearby.
